# Editor Definition Language (EDD)

Module node for `specifications/edd/`, the definition language for editors (placeholder). The normative content is [EDD-specification.md](EDD-specification.md) (`edd-specification`), with its schema `edd.schema.json` and its examples (`.edd`) beside it. This node records only what the language is for and where its boundary runs.

## Responsibility

Will store editors users create of an EDSL-specified type. It is a placeholder with nothing normative until an editor needs it.

## Boundary

Placeholder: its document states purpose and extension only, and it has no schema. Editors that exist today are host code and store plain text files, so no editor definition document exists yet (see `edsl`).
